items.q: So he had, uh, Billie Holiday, Teddy Wilson, Hazel Scott, Lena Horne... They was all workin' in the... in Cafe Society...along with Meade Lux Lewis

ctx.x: He was puttin' in these shows with John. John Hammond was puttin' shows down at the Cafe Society. So he had, uh, Billie Holiday, Teddy Wilson, Hazel Scott, Lena Horne, Twelve Clouds...no, it wasn't the Twelve Clouds, it was, uh...the Golden Gate Quartet. They was all workin' in the... in Cafe Society...along with Meade Lux Lewis and Pete Joh...I mean, Albert Ammons. So the show was overloaded in the first place.
